title: On the composition of permutons
summary: Permutons can be thought of as "continuum limits" of permutations of diverging size, which encode information about the number of occurrences of any given finite subpattern. We construct a natural composition operation on permutons, analogous to composition of permutations, and explore its properties via a correspondence between permutons, Markov kernels, and Markov operators.
